description: Call before you pay, hire, or allocate to any agent, service or company. Returns one signed verdict (mizan.verdict/1): decision ALLOW or REFUSE first, then the grade earned, the bar met or one stable reason code, the rule and its hash, what was measured, and a compact token (mzv1.…) the payee verifies offline with MIZAN's published key. Proceed only on ALLOW. Free. Without a rule MIZAN's default bar applies: a passing record in good standing (never DECLARED); with a rule (a published req_…@v, the rule require() wrote, or plain words with confirm=true) your rule decides. payee (+ bind.amount) binds the token to one payment. A REFUSE carries next.proof_request: a request you can send the party so it proves itself. subject = an agent id, a company domain, a service URL (API, MCP or A2A endpoint), a credential id, or a public AI model (model:<org>/<name>). compat=true returns the previous, longer check shape for one version. Errors come back as {error, field, got, reason, fix} and are never an ALLOW.

api_key.description: Optional MIZAN key (mzn_…): the check counts toward your record as a careful counterparty.

bind.description: Optional: bind the signed answer to one payment, so it cannot be reused for another. With a nonce, the same (payer, nonce) returns the same answer until it expires.

amount.description: The amount, as you state it (labelled unverified).

nonce.description: At least 128 bits: 32+ hex or 22+ base64url characters.

payer.description: You, the payer (your id, domain or address).

compat.description: true = the previous, longer check shape, kept for one version (clients that validate outputSchema: use https://studio.mizan.market/mcp/legacy).

confirm.description: Only for a rule in plain words: true once its read-back says what you mean.

payee.description: Optional: the party you will pay (its id or address). The token is then bound to it (bound_to.payee) and the payee or rail checks that offline; a payee that is not the subject is a REFUSE (payee_mismatch).

rule.description: Optional: your bar. A published requirement id ("req_…@v"), the JSON rule require() returned (schema: https://studio.mizan.market/app/schemas/requirement-rule-v2.schema.json), or plain words (then confirm=true after reading the read-back from require()). Without a rule, MIZAN's default bar applies.

subject.description: Who you are about to pay, hire or allocate to: an agent id, a company domain (example.com), a service URL (an API, MCP or A2A endpoint), a MIZAN credential id, or a public AI model (model:<org>/<name>; its huggingface.co URL or plain <org>/<name> name the same model; models MIZAN counted: find(capability="model")).

ttl.description: Optional: seconds the verdict stays valid (default 3600).

name: check
